### Quick Tips

- **Traffic:** Peak morning rush hour (7–9 am) and evening rush hour (4–6 pm) can add 30–60 minutes. Check real‑time traffic apps (Google Maps, Waze) before you leave.
- **Tolls:** I‑95 N and MA‑3 N have tolls. Have an E‑ZPass or cash ready.
- **Rest Stops:** There are several rest areas along I‑95 N; consider a quick break if you’re traveling early in the morning.

---

| **Amtrak (Northeast Regional)** | 3 h 30 min | Depart from Penn Station, arrive at Boston’s South Station. |
| **Bus (Greyhound, Megabus, BoltBus)** | 3 h 45 min | Departs from various NYC locations; arrives at Boston’s South Station. |
| **Flight** | 1 h flight + airport time | Flights from LaGuardia/John F. Kennedy to Logan International Airport. Usually not faster when factoring check‑in and security. |
